priorAttempts.issue: Operator first used system Python without botocore; no resources created; no project defect diagnosed.
A removed desiredCount=0 service remained INACTIVE in ListServices; the probe initially treated its presence as active. Subsequent DescribeServices verified INACTIVE.

The first runtime trial had a narrower role. DeleteService removed task API records, causing IndexError in cleanup inspection. Independent read-only closure verified containers exited, definitions/service INACTIVE and ALB/TGs/role removed. Final trial covered all reference IAM actions and had no cleanup errors.

conclusion.observed: Create/Describe retain BLUE_GREEN, bakeTime and traffic configuration. UpdateService serves the candidate through the primary blue TG, with alternate TG empty and production weights unchanged in every sample. Both revisions were not observed together.
conclusion.inference: For this LocalStack version and Docker/bridge/ip scenario, the tested UpdateService path replaces the primary TG runtime rather than executing the required native Blue/Green flow. Other networking combinations and future emulator versions were not tested.
conclusion.awsTarget: The standard CodePipeline ECS action can deliver image changes to an AWS native Blue/Green service; AWS EC2/bridge/instance execution remains unvalidated.
conclusion.decision: Keep native stage8 standard ECS pipeline, keep stage9 pending, retain no custom deployment controller, do not start CloudFront.
